about: Made-up inputs (no real user data) with the outputs bge-small-jobfinder-v2 expects. Text fields must match exactly; cosines within 1e-3. 'rule' status means the requirement goes to the rule checks, not the embedding.

job.title: Senior Backend Engineer
job.description_text:
Examplecorp builds scheduling software for clinics. We are a team of forty people. Our mission is to make booking a doctor as easy as ordering food. We value kindness, ownership and shipping small. Salary range $150k-$180k plus equity. This role is hybrid in Boston.
## What you'll do
Design and run Go services on Postgres. Own our event pipeline on Kafka. Mentor two junior engineers. 5+ years of backend experience required. Visa sponsorship is not available.

background.summary: Backend engineer who likes boring, reliable systems. Open to relocation to Boston.
